name: buildbotprime
description: Desktop builder automation twin for driving AI IDEs and local project runners.

scripts.build: npm run clean:desktop && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:packages: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/product-knowledge/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/model-providers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/project-runner/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/observer/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/secure-storage/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:desktop: vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/product-knowledge/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/model-providers/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/project-runner/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/observer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/secure-storage/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run clean:desktop && npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config apps/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron apps/desktop"
